focus.jbig: FOMC decision at 2 PM today · Iran attack overnight · mega-cap tech tonight
focus.jtag: Fed decision (markets see ~30% hike odds), Iran missile attack on U.S. base intercepted, oil up ~3–4%, MSFT/META report tonight
focus.jnote: Three catalysts stacked on one day. First and biggest: the Fed’s two-day meeting concludes today with a 2:00 PM ET decision and a Warsh press conference at 2:30 — markets lean to a hold at 3.50–3.75% but still price meaningful hike odds. Iran launched a surprise ballistic-missile attack on a U.S. base in Jordan overnight; all missiles were intercepted, but it revived Middle East supply fear and pushed WTI up ~3–4% toward $82, clawing back the prior day’s drop. Third, Microsoft and Meta report after today’s close — AI-capex guidance into a jittery chip tape. Equity futures nonetheless steadied (S&P +0.2%, Nasdaq flat), and the dollar barely moved. This is a YELLOW-by-rule tape: a scheduled Fed event caps it, and the overnight geopolitics only reinforce short DTE and half size.
focus.notdown: Today’s one boarded name is PEY — a same-day breakout in a high-dividend, low-beta ETF, exactly the kind of defensive vehicle that behaves in a jittery tape. But it’s a Grade B, same-day breakout with a one-sided/unquoted options market and unknown earnings gate, and the Fed lands at 2 PM. Any bull put must be tiny, must clear the decision, and only after liquidity is confirmed on the platform.
focus.notup: Chips / AI-heavy tech (NVDA, MU, AMD) stay pressured after SK Hynix posted a record quarter that still missed the loftiest AI expectations. That’s a fundamental lean lower, but selling bear calls into an FOMC afternoon — where one dovish line can rip a squeeze — plus MSFT/META prints tonight is not a probability edge. Stand aside on new bearish premium until the Fed and the tech prints clear.
focus.why: Why YELLOW, not GREEN? The FOMC decision is inside the next 24h (2 PM ET today) — the master rule says a scheduled Fed event in the window cannot be GREEN and defaults to YELLOW (A-grade only, half size, DTE that clears the event). Composite ~58 is in WARM and P(≥1% gap) ~36% is just over the 35% line — either alone caps GREEN. The overnight Iran attack was intercepted and markets took it calmly, so this isn’t RED — but between the Fed at 2 PM, an active Gulf conflict, and mega-cap tech tonight, disciplined sizing and short DTE are non-negotiable.
